investment_thesis: Kuraray holds dominant global positions in specialty resins and optical film, and the latest year marks the bottom of the observed margin range rather than a loss of those positions; the shares trade at {per} earnings and {pb} book.
The stock changes hands well below the Japanese chemical peer median on EV/EBITDA, which is where the exit leg of this model finds value against a {wacc} cost of capital.
At {price} the market prices the trough margin as the new normal; restoring the midpoint between the observed peak and trough supports {target_price}, or {upside_pct} from here.
key_risks: Reported net income collapsed to a fraction of the prior year while operating income fell far less, so the {per} the market pays at {price} is measured against an earnings base distorted by one-off charges.
Capital expenditure has risen to above 12% of revenue against depreciation of 10.5%, and the base case assumes the two converge rather than the spending staying elevated.

Demand for optical film and specialty resins is tied to display and automotive cycles, and a further downturn would hold margins at the trough used in the second downside case rather than at the level {target_price} assumes.
_beta_note: 実測（raw）β = 0.7613。出所: TOPIX 2y 1wk OLS (n=104, corr=0.462)。フェーズ2 #6 以降 overrides の beta は raw を入れる契約で、テンプレが Blume 調整 0.67×raw + 0.33×1.00 を掛け [0.3, 2.0] にクランプする（採用 0.8401、クランプ非発動）。■旧 overrides の値 0.6 は旧ルール [0.6, 1.75] のクランプ後の値であり raw ではない。■yfinance の beta フィールドは 0.054。日本株では市場を説明しないベンチマークで算出されており（NTT −0.165 / 大阪ガス −0.201 等）、採用しない。詳細は docs/phase2_pipeline_fixes_20260906.md の §2-4。
